reviews.text: My experience was not good. I arrived to vaccinate my puppy early in the morning, and there was only one other dog ahead of him. My dog ​​is terrified of vets, and I had already told them that. There were several vets there, going back and forth, and even so, they left my dog ​​waiting for an hour, seeing the animal's stress. They still left him waiting for an hour, even though it didn't take them 5 minutes to give the vaccine. You can see that they have no love for animals there, only for the money! My dog ​​got so stressed that he had a heart attack. The receptionists are wonderful, but the vets were slow. I won't go back; my dog ​​won't go through that stress. When I need help, I'll go to another clinic. What's the point of having many vets if the service is slow?

I went to say goodbye to my cat. They have an ecumenical space, with an altar and armchairs for saying goodbye.
I felt welcomed, respected for the human's feelings towards their departed pet, as it's inconceivable to imagine throwing them away anywhere.
Artemis was my companion for almost 17 years, and the time between her illness and death was just days.
They charge by the animal's weight; in my case, she weighed only 2 kilos.

The service was wonderful, Dr. Emily was sensational, she treated my kitten Nino with so much love and attention, with the utmost care. The receptionists were also wonderful. The hospital deserves congratulations to all the teams, I can only express my gratitude. 🙌❤️ …

Once again I was scammed at this clinic with false exams and diagnoses, and exorbitant prices. This isn't the first time my animal has had this problem... terrible, zero points, I'll never set foot in there again... #bocatv

My dog ​​was hit by a car, we immediately took her to this "hospital," they did an x-ray and ultrasound, and the images showed that she had broken a rib, there was fluid in her abdomen, and they tried to insert a catheter to see if her bladder had ruptured, but they couldn't. The recommendation was to admit her, do another ultrasound to monitor if the fluid in her abdomen would increase, and we authorized it, paying everything, 1580 in cash.
The doctor said that he didn't see the need for surgery, it was more for monitoring, and that she would be discharged the next day.
We admitted her around 9:30 PM, and at 12:30 AM they called me and we went to the clinic, and they informed us that our little pet had suffered a respiratory arrest and died. I questioned whether everything was done to save her, everything they promised - the doctor's words (we were waiting for the test results that would come out the next day, to see the course of action to be followed) but if the case was an emergency, why did they keep her there if they didn't have the necessary support? Why did they say our girl was okay when even they didn't know if she was actually okay?
This isn't the first pet we've lost there due to false hope and vague diagnoses.
I have two other pets at home, and I would never take them to this place again. Today I was certain of this place's incompetence.
It's sad; if you want to save your pet, stay far away from this "hospital" during an emergency.
Not to mention the absurd price.

I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to the entire hospital team for the care they gave Cacau and Zé Leoncio during their hospitalization.

Although I had some less positive experiences years ago, today I want to acknowledge the excellent care we received. I am very grateful to the entire team, with special thanks to Dr. Bárbara, Dr. Lucas, Dr. Samanta, and Dr. Túlio, the neurologist, for all their care, attention, and affection.

During such a difficult time for us, having such dedicated professionals made all the difference. I am very grateful for everything they did for my little ones. ❤️🐾

Everyone is very polite and friendly, but it takes a long time to be seen, to have tests done, etc.
My dog ​​was hospitalized, his condition worsened overnight, he wasn't responding to the medication, they needed to change it and waited until the next day to ask me for authorization to change it and pay the price! I didn't like it, they should have told me sooner, what mattered to me was his health, not the money I had to pay!
I don't recommend it and I won't be back!!!

I would like to express my deepest gratitude for the impeccable care my cat Mya received during her stay in the hospital. A very special thank you to Dr. Emilly and also to the entire on-call team. Everyone was extremely professional, caring, and attentive to her, which gave me a lot of security and peace of mind during a difficult time. Their love and dedication to animals is evident. I recommend them without hesitation!
Dr. Júlia was perfect in her care and diagnosis! Thank God it wasn't anything serious, but we will need treatment!

THEY KILLED MY DOG FOR MONEY

My dog ​​arrived at the clinic alive, having difficulty breathing, but conscious and breathing. That same day, he had undergone several tests, including cardiac exams, which indicated that he was in excellent cardiovascular condition.

During the consultation, I was informed that it would be necessary to transport him in a veterinary ambulance, at an approximate cost of R$ 7,000.00. As I had my own car and the location of the next appointment was about 15 minutes away, I informed them that I would transport him myself. I noticed displeasure from the staff with my decision.

I left to get the car and, when I returned, my dog ​​had died. The justification given was a supposed cardiac arrest, which greatly surprised me given the exams performed that same day and the state in which he arrived at the clinic.

My dog ​​went in alive and came out dead. I was deeply shaken and to this day I can't understand what happened during the time he was under the team's care. The situation was extremely painful and left many questions unanswered, especially regarding the necessity of the ambulance and the high price charged.
If you love your pet, don't take it there.
Very caring with the pets. Excellent service!

It has some good doctors and nursing staff, but it commits a fundamental sin: it doesn't accept inpatients!! It would be the same as a human patient arriving at the public health system (SUS) needing hospitalization, being treated, and then being sent away because there were no beds available!! Lamentable 😕 …

Excellent facilities and staff, super attentive and caring.
I recommend them to anyone who needs their services.

Unfortunately, I only found this hospital during the saddest time of my life, but since then I have complete trust in the professionals. Juliana provides incredible care, making you feel welcomed from the moment you arrive. Some time ago, my baby was cared for with so much love by Dr. Bárbara, who was an angel at that time and closely followed our situation, showing complete empathy.

Humanity... That's the word that describes the care I received at this veterinary hospital.
Thank you to everyone who helped save my puppy's life.
I lost one a year ago, but I know they did everything they could... And this year, I took the father of the puppy who passed away and they helped me a lot. The veterinarians who treated me were wonderful, I don't remember each one's name but they are etched in my memory. Thank you.
Great service, excellent.
Wonderful team saved my kitten 😇❤

Terrible place, they take advantage of your vulnerability and fragility in the face of your pet's suffering. They push you into a bunch of unnecessary tests just to make you spend more money. My cat almost ended up on an operating table. Luckily, I took him to another veterinarian who showed a completely different picture than what they had told me. I would have spent even more money unnecessarily.
My cat is much better now, and it wasn't thanks to this clinic. Don't take your pet there.

I took my kitten for an ultrasound at night and we received excellent service.

I recommend them! 👏🏻

I want to express my special thanks to Dr. Lucas, who was a true angel taking care of Caramelo and Bilbo. His competence, dedication, and sensitivity made all the difference during such a difficult time. Beyond his excellent medical conduct, he provided security, support, and great care for my cats. My sincere gratitude for everything he did for them.
It was a great experience, if it weren't for having to leave our dog hospitalized. Dr. Guilherme and the staff at the reception were super nice...
Best place to take care of your pet.
Excellent service!!! We especially thank "Veterinarian Camila" for all the attention she gave us 🙏
Excellent service! Dr. Joyce Miranda is an incredible professional, very caring and inspires a lot of confidence. The best veterinarian!
We want service for EVERYONE! And not just those registered in the Unified Registry (CadÚnico). We pay our taxes and we have the right to receive services!!!
Excellent service, great professionals.

I received excellent service, all the professionals were helpful, they took great care of my dog, Dr. Waleska was wonderful, and so was Dr. Lu. In short, everyone deserves a 1000/10!
Thank you!
Excellent
Wonderful service, excellent care for pets, simply perfect.

This hospital is only good for the first consultation; the follow-up appointments are negligent, and on weekends people do whatever they want. I've been waiting since this morning for a callback and there's no doctor available, but when it comes to selling the service, it's completely different. I don't recommend it.

I took my dog ​​from Ferraz de Vasconcelos to this 24-hour veterinary hospital, about a 45-minute drive, because she had seriously injured her paw and was crying and trembling in pain. Since it was an emergency hospital, I imagined she would be seen quickly.
Upon arrival, the place was empty. The receptionist informed me that two veterinarians were in an emergency and asked me to wait. I waited for a long time with my dog ​​suffering, without anyone even coming to assess her situation. I asked three times about the service and always received the same answer: that they were already on their way.
After quite some time, the receptionist informed me that the veterinarian would still take a while because she was admitting a patient and suggested that I look for another place. As I was leaving, another employee appeared saying that there were five veterinarians busy with emergencies. The information was contradictory and, during all this time, my dog ​​continued to be in a lot of pain without any care.

My biggest complaint is: how can a 24-hour veterinary hospital, with all that infrastructure, not have anyone available to at least do a triage in an emergency? If it were an even more serious situation, the consequences could have been very serious.
Unfortunately, my experience was extremely disappointing, and I felt completely helpless at a time when my animal needed help the most.
A good place

I was at the hospital today with my Jade, a Labrador who is suffering a lot from dysplasia and spinal problems. I was extremely stressed seeing my pet in that situation and had a very strong anxiety attack when I arrived. Dr. Alexa, the physiotherapist, came down to talk to me so we could go upstairs and start physiotherapy. She is wonderful, a professional that is a rarity these days. Besides calming me down a lot, she is very loving and helped Jade relax. My thanks and gratitude to her. I hope the hospital continues to bring in professionals like her with such high capabilities, because I've known the hospital since it opened, and unfortunately, I know very few professionals like her.

Humanity - That's the word that sums up our feelings regarding the São Paulo Veterinary Hospital.

Unfortunately, we are saddened to lose our kitten Luna — or, as we called her because she was so mischievous, Luna Luneta.

From the emergency room entrance to her hospitalization, from the reception area to the care and sensitivity of Doctors Amanda and Nathalia, we never felt abandoned.

Every call, every word, the paw print on the condolence note, and the little hairs on the jar left us with one certainty: we sought out the right place with the right professionals.

Thank you to the entire team, thank you for making this moment less painful.

Goodbye, Luna Luneta. The Valente family loved you intensely during these 6 months.

I left my dog ​​hospitalized overnight, I paid almost R$1,300.00, the doctor who attended us said that the nails would be trimmed, when I picked up the dog the next day another doctor said that the nails are only trimmed if the dog is also groomed and bathed. One doctor says one thing, another says something else. The truth is that in other clinics, they always trimmed the nails during consultations, you spend that amount of money and they don't even do that.
Very good place for animal care and emergency services.

Excellent place
Great service, very attentive staff and very affordable price, I recommend it! I would give more stars if I could.
Excellent service

I took my Fred to this hospital...
He received the correct diagnosis, had tests done, and was hospitalized for about 4 days.

But his condition was very bad.
He was an old dog, and then he passed away 😢😟
But he only received love and was very well cared for by Dr. Camila, Samanta, and Natália...
I want to thank everyone, from the doctors and reception staff to everyone else... thank you so much for the care and attention you gave us....🐾🐕

The medical care leaves much to be desired. I took my cat for supposed treatment of a urinary tract infection; a doctor gave a diagnosis, but after the treatment period, there were no results. Returning to the clinic, another doctor gave a different opinion on the problem. In short... I spent a lot of money, only heard empty promises, and now I'm scrambling to find another clinic. The doctors are clueless...

An excellent hospital, with professional and specialized care. I would like to highlight the work of veterinarian Waleska, who provided the initial care to our dear friend Teddy. I thank all the professionals involved in providing care. We were welcomed from beginning to end.

Today I took my dog ​​to the veterinary clinic. She was lethargic, unable to eat, and had pain in her paws. Before going, I called the clinic and they informed me that the consultation fee at that time would be R$ 50.00.

However, upon arrival, my dog ​​was taken to a room called "emergency consultation," where they began performing some tests, such as blood glucose, blood pressure measurement, and cardiac auscultation. Given this, I questioned whether these procedures were included in the previously quoted consultation fee, and the veterinarian told me no. She informed me that the emergency consultation would cost R$ 180.00, in addition to the initial consultation of R$ 50.00, totaling R$ 230.00.

The problem is that I was only informed of these costs after the tests had already been performed on my dog.

Furthermore, the veterinarians said that the tests were within normal limits and that the condition could be related to pain. Next, they administered medication intravenously.

When my dog ​​was almost finished with the medication, she started to feel unwell beside me. Desperate, I called a veterinarian, but unfortunately, she passed away.

In the end, I took my dog, who had seemingly mild symptoms, and returned home without her.

Furthermore, the clinic already made a mistake by not correctly informing me of the prices from the beginning. DO NOT GO!
